text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only a few days remain until tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Th-th-th-this is a disaster! I'm ruined!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Classes are done for the day. A flustered
Matikanefukukitaru bursts
into the
trainers' room.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaah! What do I dooooo?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniff... So I was doing a divination earlier to see how tryouts would turn out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And it said that I would experience a
great
misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The harbinger of death is upon me! I must
rid myself of this evil!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Extra! Extra! Breaking news—hot off the
press!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you talking about, Taiki? I've
got a bad feeling about
this...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: They announced the groups for the tryouts! Fukukitaru, you won't believe who you're going against! It's gonna blow your mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle begins to recite the list of
runners, and Matikanefukukitaru's face
grows more pale with every additional

name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the runners in her group are extremely
skilled—certainly good
enough to make
their debuts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Arghhh! I'm done for! The race hasn't even
begun, and it's already
over!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is what the divination meant by
misfortune—I'm sure of it! Why
did I even
bother?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a look of defeat,
Matikanefukukitaru's shoulders slump, and
she
very gloomily goes about her training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nnnnrgh! Fiiinally done!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... You don't need to tell me my time. I already know I didn't do well today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sounds good to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's impossible to break free from the shackles of destiny, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But I already knew that.
I just didn't want
to accept it—that I'm not
good enough to
run in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I actually have an older sister.
She's good at everything—the perfect
model child. So
people would often compare the two of
us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong,
it's not like I hate my
sister! If anything, I really
respect her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's just really hard not to compare
myself
with her at times...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I mean, I wasn't even sure of whether or not I should—or well, could—attend Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But in the midst of my angst, the great
Shiraoki appeared by my side
and told
me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Run! Run, and the path before you shall
open!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I took her words to heart and ran as fast
and as hard as I could. Her
guidance is why
I'm even here at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Matikanefukukitaru pour her
heart out, I'm reminded of
our
conversation the other day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I'm ever feeling lost, down,
or anxious, she cheers me up—makes
me feel better!
She even helped me during my scrimmage
with Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The reason why I'm even here right now is
all thanks to the great
Shiraoki! I chose to
believe in her, and that brought me to
where I am today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm unsure what Matikanefukukitaru means
when she talks about this Shiraoki being,
but whatever her reasons, the divinations
seem to be
motivating her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The divinations and fortune-telling are
dear to her, and they have indeed helped
her get this far. That much I can tell.
Perhaps I can put
this information to use...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But my luck has already hit rock
bottom! You wouldn't find a gal as jinxed
as me even if you tried! Running in this
state would be
completely pointless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is reluctant to resume
her training, but I
eventually sway her, and
we commence round two of our training.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I can't do this... anymore... My body... won't move...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The divination was right...
Today's training
is nothing but misfortune
after
misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you talking about? I
completely and utterly believe in
them, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All the fortune-telling I've ever done has
led me to where I am today!
It's basically
my entire life!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So it's not a question of whether or not I
believe in them. They're
true—they have
to be.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You're the trainer who will
change my fate!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to prove myself at the
next tryouts—to show you
the results of all
my hard training!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just... run?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh,
I think I get it! You're right! I was
being such a fool!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I have to quit dwelling on the outcomes
and focus on running! Fortune
or
misfortune, I need to run my best during
tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes to get
scouted by
you! That's my goal!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Screw you, misfortune! I'm going to charge ahead and show you what I'm really capable of!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, I think I'm ready for another
round of running! Come at me, world! I'll
rise to whatever challenge you have in
store with everything
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a renewed look of pure resolve, the
now energized
Matikanefukukitaru once
again dashes off into the distance.
